info.title: POLAR WINDOW
info.description:
Sun, Earth and terrain geometry for candidate landing sites at the Moon's south pole.

Four numbers decide a mission and this API exists to serve them:

1. **Sunlit seconds** in the window — power
2. **Earth-contact seconds** in the window — direct-to-Earth comms
3. **Longest unbroken dark gap** — survival
4. **Longest unbroken comms blackout** — autonomy

There is deliberately **no composite score**. A score ranks sites on one axis and
hides which corner was given up, and the trade is the product.

Every response carries a `meta` object with `computed_at`, `resolution` and
`uncertainty`. `uncertainty` is never absent and never null: where a value cannot
be known, the field says so (`grazing: true`, `edge_timing_s: null`) rather than
reporting a plausible number.

**Not an official product of any space agency.** Data product names are the public
identifiers of the inputs, nothing more.

get.description:
Every agent invocation, whatever its outcome.

Shown in the demo. It is the proof that the AI layer is real, bounded and
checked -- including the runs where the guard rejected an answer, which are
the interesting ones.

post.summary: Sign in as the project manager
post.description:
A project manager's session, with no user name or password.

For a judged demo: the landing page's "Open the dashboard" button calls
this. Turned off with `PW_DEMO_SIGN_IN=false`, when it answers 403.

put.summary: Turn the AI on or off and order its models

post.description: Forget every model's cooldown, e.g. after the key's quota was raised.

requirement.title: Requirement
requirement.description: A mission requirement in plain language, e.g. 'at least 4 hours of Earth contact per day and no night longer than 100 hours'.

agents_configured.title: Agents Configured
agents_configured.description: False without an API key or under OFFLINE=1.

AgentMeta.title: AgentMeta
AgentMeta.description: The shared `meta` envelope for agent answers and the run log.

AgentResolution.title: AgentResolution
AgentResolution.description: What the answer's numbers were computed at: those of the tools it called.

run_status.title: Run Status
run_status.description: Why this answer is what it is, exactly as recorded in the run log. `status` folds the last four into `degraded`; this keeps them apart.

guard_failures.title: Guard Failures
guard_failures.description: Guards that fired, including ones a retry then fixed. Kept so the guard can be shown working rather than asserted to exist.

AgentResponse.title: AgentResponse
AgentResponse.description:
Shared envelope for all four agents.

`provenance` is produced by the grounding guard, not by the model, and is
not optional. It is the artifact that makes the guard demonstrable rather
than merely claimed.

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.description: Every number in the answer traced to a tool result (always true for an answer that is shown; a failed check replaces the text with the measurements).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: False: every AI panel answers from the measurements.

configured.title: Configured
configured.description: A model API key is set and the server is not offline. Without it the switch has nothing to turn on.

customised.title: Customised
customised.description: False while the configured defaults apply.

models.title: Models
models.description: The main list, in the order tried.

models_light.title: Models Light
models_light.description: The list for short explanations, in the order tried.

tolerance_s.title: Tolerance S
tolerance_s.description: Timing uncertainty of this arc's duration: the quadrature sum of its two edges' tolerances.

start_tolerance_s.title: Start Tolerance S
start_tolerance_s.description: Timing uncertainty of the crossing that starts this arc; null when the arc starts at the window edge rather than at a crossing.

end_tolerance_s.title: End Tolerance S
end_tolerance_s.description: As `start_tolerance_s`, for the crossing that ends it.

grazing.title: Grazing
grazing.description: True when a crossing is too shallow to time. The duration stands; its edges do not.

blocked_by_bearing_deg.title: Blocked By Bearing Deg
blocked_by_bearing_deg.description: For a blocked arc, the bearing of the terrain doing the blocking. Naming the cause is the difference between an answer and an assertion.

open_start.title: Open Start
open_start.description: The arc begins at the window start: it was already in progress, so its true start -- and duration -- lie beyond the window.

open_end.title: Open End
open_end.description: The arc is still in progress at the window end.

Arc.title: Arc
Arc.description: One unbroken stretch above or below the skyline.

required_autonomy_s.title: Required Autonomy S
required_autonomy_s.description: The worst compound event (no Sun and no link) plus `margin_fraction`.

margin_fraction.title: Margin Fraction
margin_fraction.description: The margin applied on top of the worst compound event, as a fraction.

survival_needed_s.title: Survival Needed S
survival_needed_s.description: The battery must carry the longest night whatever the radio is doing; a blackout inside a night never shortens it.

survival_open.title: Survival Open
survival_open.description: The night that sets `survival_needed_s` is cut by a window edge: a lower bound.

longest_down_open.title: Longest Down Open
longest_down_open.description: The longest down arc touches a window edge; `longest_down_s` is a lower bound on the stretch it belongs to.

longest_dark_open.title: Longest Dark Open
longest_dark_open.description: The longest night in this bucket was cut by the bucket's edge: a lower bound.

CalendarResponse.title: CalendarResponse
CalendarResponse.description: Sun and Earth by day or by month, for choosing dates (contract v2).

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: How many records went; null when there was no store.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Definite competition rank, shared by measured sites whose intervals overlap (1, 1, 3). Null when a window-censored value or an untimeable edge is involved, so the place cannot be stated: read `rank_range` instead.

rank_range.title: Rank Range
rank_range.description: [best possible, worst possible] place given every site's interval.

tied.title: Tied
tied.description: Overlaps at least one other measured site.

tied_with.title: Tied With
tied_with.description: Measured sites this one cannot be separated from.

incomparable_with.title: Incomparable With
incomparable_with.description: Sites this one cannot be ordered against because a lower bound or an untimeable edge is involved.

censored.title: Censored
censored.description: The ranked value is a lower bound: the window, not the terrain, ended it.

grazing.title: Grazing
grazing.description: An edge of the ranked value cannot be timed.

uncertainty_s.title: Uncertainty S
uncertainty_s.description: This site's own timing tolerance on the ranked metric; null when grazing.

rank_by.title: Rank By
rank_by.description: One of sunlit_s, earth_contact_s, longest_dark_s, longest_blackout_s. There is no composite option by design.

ties.title: Ties
ties.description: Connected groups of measured sites whose intervals overlap. Reported rather than ordered: ranking sites the data cannot distinguish asserts a difference that is not there.

unavailable.title: Unavailable
unavailable.description: Sites that could not be computed. One unsurveyed site does not blank the comparison.

cached_results.title: Cached Results
cached_results.description: Null when the cache is not in use.

status.title: Status
status.description: `degraded` still returns 200: a missing elevation model leaves every ephemeris endpoint working and the UI has a state for partial data. Only a missing ephemeris or database is `down`.

HorizonResponse.title: HorizonResponse
HorizonResponse.description:
Azimuth -> skyline elevation.

Parallel arrays rather than objects: 1440 entries x 3 fields is ~60 KB as
arrays and ~250 KB as a list of objects, and the frontend indexes them by
bin anyway.

longest_dark_open.title: Longest Dark Open
longest_dark_open.description: The longest night touches a window edge, so `longest_dark_s` is a lower bound: the window ended it, not the terrain.

sunlit_full_disc_s.title: Sunlit Full Disc S
sunlit_full_disc_s.description: Time the whole solar disc was above the skyline (lower bound on sunlit_s; sampled at the timeline step). sunlit_s times the disc centre.

sunlit_any_limb_s.title: Sunlit Any Limb S
sunlit_any_limb_s.description: Time any part of the solar disc was above the skyline (upper bound).

sunlit_tolerance_s.title: Sunlit Tolerance S
sunlit_tolerance_s.description: Timing uncertainty of the sunlit total: every skyline crossing's edge tolerance, added in quadrature. Seconds.

earth_contact_tolerance_s.title: Earth Contact Tolerance S
earth_contact_tolerance_s.description: Timing uncertainty of the Earth-contact total, as for sunlit. Seconds.

longest_dark_tolerance_s.title: Longest Dark Tolerance S
longest_dark_tolerance_s.description: Tolerance of the longest night's two edges in quadrature; null when an edge is a graze and cannot be timed. Seconds.

longest_blackout_tolerance_s.title: Longest Blackout Tolerance S
longest_blackout_tolerance_s.description: Tolerance of the longest blackout's two edges; null when grazing. Seconds.

MetricsResponse.title: MetricsResponse
MetricsResponse.description:
The four numbers. There is deliberately no composite score.

A score ranks sites on one axis, which destroys exactly the information this
product exists to show: which corner a site gives up. The absence of a
`score` field here is asserted by a test.

site_id.title: Site Id
site_id.description: The site standing for the target; open it for the full site views.

terrain_modelled.title: Terrain Modelled
terrain_modelled.description: False outside the 80-90 deg S elevation model; null with no target.

summary.description: Null when there is no surface window or no target. Never zeros.

site_id.title: Site Id
site_id.description: The site standing for the target; open it for the full site views.

terrain_modelled.title: Terrain Modelled
terrain_modelled.description: False outside the 80-90 deg S elevation model; null with no target.

summary.description: Null when there is no surface window or no target. Never zeros.

ellipse_ring.title: Ellipse Ring
ellipse_ring.description: Published landing ellipse as [lat, lon] vertices; null when none is published.

MissionSummary.title: MissionSummary
MissionSummary.description: The four numbers at the target over the surface window.

coordinate_kind.title: Coordinate Kind
coordinate_kind.description: `feature_centre` is the IAU centre of the named target, used because no landing point is published. It is not a landing point.

skipped_until.title: Skipped Until
skipped_until.description: When a skipped model is tried again; null when it is ready.

why.title: Why
why.description: Why it is being skipped, in words.

instrument_types.title: Instrument Types
instrument_types.description: This project's classification from the sourced description, not NASA's.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description:
How a site's coordinate came to exist.

Carried on every site because these coordinates are *derived* -- the IAU
coordinate for a named crater is its centre, which is the permanently
shadowed floor and the worst place to land. A site that did not say how it
was chosen would be asking to be trusted for no reason.

date.title: Date
date.description: ISO date or datetime. A year-precision date is 1 January.

as_published.title: As Published
as_published.description: The phrase as published, e.g. 'late 2027'. Show this.

azimuth_deg.title: Azimuth Deg
azimuth_deg.description: Angular step of the horizon mask, degrees.

time_step_s.title: Time Step S
time_step_s.description: Sampling step of the timeline, seconds.

max_range_m.title: Max Range M
max_range_m.description: How far terrain was modelled around the site.

Resolution.title: Resolution
Resolution.description: What this answer was computed at.

role_name.title: Role Name
role_name.description: The role as the screen names it.

token.title: Token
token.description: A JWT (HS256). Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

elev_m.title: Elev M
elev_m.description: Height above the 1737.4 km reference sphere, metres. Null where no elevation model covers the site: an unknown height is not zero.

search_kind.title: Search Kind
search_kind.description: How the landing point was found: on the rim of a named crater (so it borders that crater's shadowed floor) or on a massif or plateau.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A derived candidate site, or a CLPS mission target (ADR-6).

coordinate_rule.title: Coordinate Rule
coordinate_rule.description: Searched in the DEM for open sky, or used exactly as published.

terrain_modelled.title: Terrain Modelled
terrain_modelled.description: False outside the 80-90 deg S elevation model: smooth-sphere skyline.

elev_m.title: Elev M
elev_m.description: Height above the 1737.4 km reference sphere, metres. Null where no elevation model covers the site: an unknown height is not zero.

search_kind.title: Search Kind
search_kind.description: How the landing point was found: on the rim of a named crater (so it borders that crater's shadowed floor) or on a massif or plateau.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A derived candidate site, or a CLPS mission target (ADR-6).

coordinate_rule.title: Coordinate Rule
coordinate_rule.description: Searched in the DEM for open sky, or used exactly as published.

terrain_modelled.title: Terrain Modelled
terrain_modelled.description: False outside the 80-90 deg S elevation model: smooth-sphere skyline.

longest_dark_open.title: Longest Dark Open
longest_dark_open.description: The longest night touches an edge of the reference window, so the window ended it and `longest_dark_s` is a lower bound.

longest_blackout_open.title: Longest Blackout Open
longest_blackout_open.description: As `longest_dark_open`, for the longest loss of Earth contact.

SiteSummary.title: SiteSummary
SiteSummary.description:
Coarse four-numbers over the reference window.

`null` on a site whose precompute has not run -- never zeros. A zero is a
measurement; absence is absence, and the UI has a state for it.

status.title: Status
status.description: ok, degraded or down, as /healthz reports it.

moon_data.title: Moon Data
moon_data.description: The south-polar elevation model is present.

ToolCallView.title: ToolCallView
ToolCallView.description: One tool call, as shown in the demo's run log.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which uncertainty envelope this is (ADR-9). Surface answers are always `terrain`; lifecycle answers carry a `composite` envelope instead.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Fraction of sampled terrain that fell inside the elevation model. Below 1.0 the mask is partial and the numbers are likely optimistic.

horizon_el_deg.title: Horizon El Deg
horizon_el_deg.description: Angular uncertainty of the skyline, from the DEM's vertical error at the range where the skyline is actually set.

edge_timing_s.title: Edge Timing S
edge_timing_s.description: Worst arc-edge timing uncertainty in this response, seconds. null when at least one crossing is a graze -- see `grazing`. A null here is a stronger statement than a large number: the edge is not knowable from this data.

penumbra_sun_deg.title: Penumbra Sun Deg
penumbra_sun_deg.description: Apparent angular radius of the Sun from the Moon. The lit/dark boundary is soft by this much.

terrain_modelled.title: Terrain Modelled
terrain_modelled.description: False when no elevation model covers the site (a CLPS target outside 80 deg S): the skyline is a smooth sphere, so real terrain could block more.

Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty
Uncertainty.description: How wrong this could be, in the units the caller is reading.

role_name.title: Role Name
role_name.description: The role as the screen names it.

HTTPBearer.description: A session token from POST /auth/demo, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
